faq.a: Yes. Send us your date, group size and food requirements and Maruf Cafe will get back to you to discuss your order.

faq.q: Can I rent Maruf Cafe for a private event?
faq.a: You can ask. Send an event request with your date, event type and number of guests. Availability depends on the date and the size of your group, and nothing is booked until Maruf Cafe confirms it with you.

faq.q: How do I get a price?
faq.a: Pricing depends on the date, number of guests, event type, food requirements and rental arrangements. Send a request and Maruf Cafe will discuss the details and prices with you.

faq.q: How far ahead should I contact you?
faq.a: As early as you can. The earlier we hear from you, the better the chance we can plan around your date.
Choose Pickup or Delivery on the large order form and enter your address. Maruf Cafe will confirm whether delivery is possible for your location.

faq.q: Do I pay when I send the request?
faq.a: No. Sending a request does not charge you and does not book anything. Maruf Cafe will contact you first to confirm the details.

faq.q: Can I bring decorations or entertainment?
faq.a: Tell us about your plans in the event form and we will discuss it with you.
